title: Finite etale lifting descends through henselian finite-presentation limits
statement: Let (A,I) be a henselian pair and Y proper over Spec A. Express A as a filtered colimit of henselian Noetherian G-ring pairs (A_j,I_j) with compatible proper finite-presentation models Y_j. Then finite etale covers of Y and of Y_0, together with their isomorphisms, descend to one index j; consequently essential surjectivity of finite etale restriction at every A_j implies essential surjectivity at A.

source.place: Fundamental Groups, Lemma 0GS2, essential-surjectivity proof, general henselian-pair limit case
